subject: Request: brief hero blurb + logo permission for GCP co-sell badge
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@rw-inference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@neurohealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@rw-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@rw-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief hero blurb + logo permission for GCP co-sell badge

Hi Priya —

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing the assets for the NeuroHealth listing on the GCP Marketplace and are preparing the co-sell badge page. Two quick asks if you’re able to help:

1) A one-sentence "hero blurb" (15–25 words) we can place at the top of the listing — something like a short value statement (example: “Redwood Inference helped us cut inference latency by 3x while reducing costs”).
2) Confirm we can display your company logo (PNG) on the GCP listing and in promotional collateral.

I’ve attached a preview of the badge layout and a suggested draft blurb to make it easy to edit. If you can reply with an approved line and attach the highest-res logo (PNG / SVG preferred) we’ll submit to the partner portal tomorrow.

If you want Legal to sign anything, let me know and we’ll route it. Appreciate the help — this co-sell badge will be a great signal for customers looking for low-latency inference on GCP.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@rw-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachment: short-testimonial-draft.txt (text/plain)
Attachment: badge-preview.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@neurohealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@rw-inference.com>
Cc: Gabe Turner <gabe.turner@neurohealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: brief hero blurb + logo permission for GCP co-sell badge

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the draft — happy to help. Quick answers:

1) Approved hero blurb (we shortened your suggestion): “NeuroHealth reduced inference latency by 70% while improving throughput for live diagnostics.”
2) Yes, you may use our logo on the GCP listing and co-marketing collateral. I’m attaching the official PNG and an SVG. Please use the color and clear-space guidelines in the attached file.

One note from our marketing team: please include the attribution line “Customer: NeuroHealth Analytics” beneath the badge if possible.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product Marketing
NeuroHealth Analytics

Attachment: neurohealth_logo_rgb.png (image/png)
Attachment: neurohealth_logo_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@rw-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@rw-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@rw-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Approved hero blurb + logo from NeuroHealth (for GCP listing)

Marissa / Laura —

Priya just approved the blurb and sent logo assets. Moving to the portal submission flow. Notes:
- Blurb (final): “NeuroHealth reduced inference latency by 70% while improving throughput for live diagnostics.”
- Logo assets attached by Priya (PNG + SVG) and marketing wants the attribution line beneath the badge.

Marissa, can you upload assets to the Drive folder below and kick off the partner portal submission? Laura, can you confirm there are no outstanding trademark/usage restrictions per our terms? If legal needs an MOU, we’ll handle it but Priya said permission is fine and marketing asked for attribution.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-neurohealth-marketplace-assets
Marketplace submission link: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/partner/submissions/12345

Thanks — will mark this as high priority to meet GCP co-sell cadence.

Jonas

Thanks — I uploaded the PNG and SVG to the shared Drive folder and created a submission draft in the Marketplace console. I included the hero blurb exactly as Priya wrote it and added the attribution line under customer name per request.

I also attached a short-format testimonial (two-sentence) for placement options. Priya, if you want to tweak the tone please feel free — I’ve added it as "short-testimonial-draft.txt" in the folder.

Attachments: short-testimonial-draft.txt (text/plain)

Redwood Inference

Cc: Gabe Turner <gabe.turner@neurohealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Approved hero blurb + logo from NeuroHealth (for GCP listing)

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, this looks good. We reviewed the short-testimonial-draft and are fine with the two-sentence version you wrote — minor edit to second sentence to be more product-specific (see below).

Final testimonial (approved): “Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by 70% and increased model throughput for live ECG diagnostics. The integration on GCP made it straightforward to scale during pilot testing.”

Gabe is copied for legal sign-off if needed, but from marketing we’re green to proceed with the assets and attribution line.

Best,
Priya
Head of Product Marketing
NeuroHealth Analytics
